title: feat(console)!: an app opens on the first `landing` entry whose `visible` holds for the reader
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw9TMGcWfAYsNMXXRo

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPS9G1UpTmAu71Liaim1Pvn)_
Fixes #28450

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/ui/apps.mdx (the `landing` row and the "Landing per audience" section: the Planned marker and the warn Callout are gone, and the fault face is stated); no file under `skills/**` teaches `app.landing`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台打开应用根地址时，按 `landing` 列表顺序判断，第一个 `visible` 成立的条目决定落地页；都不成立时仍落到第一个导航项。objectui 的 app 节点同时接上了 spec 自带的 `landing` 校验；spec 现在拒绝把 `url` 导航项写成落地目标（契约复审 6551992138 的必改项）。
- 为什么改：同一个应用给多个角色用时，以前所有人都落到同一页（把销售排前面，客服就落到线索）；规范层的 `landing` 已经合入，但控制台还没读它。
- 风险与回滚：只影响声明了 `landing` 的应用的首屏；谓词出错时跳过该条目并在浏览器控制台报一次，不会扩大任何访问权限。`url` 落地目标的拒绝只碰得到未发布的 `landing` 键（18.2.0 之后才合入），已登记迁移条目 `app-landing-url-item-refused`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appDeclaredLanding.ts`（落地规则与谓词作用域）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的 `AppRootLanding`（接线与等待读取的双问）、`ui/packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts` 末尾的 `.superRefine(checkAppLandingItems)`（收窄）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.declaredLanding-28450.test.tsx`，预期 12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The console reads `app.landing`.** On the app root (`/apps/:app`), `AppRootLanding` now resolves the route through `resolveDeclaredLandingRoute` (new, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appDeclaredLanding.ts`): the entries are asked in order, and the first whose `visible` holds opens the navigation entry its `item` names. No entry lands, or no key: `findFirstRoute` over the shown `navigation`, exactly as before.
- **The roots, pinned.** The predicate is asked with `useNavMemberGates`' `evaluateVisibility` with no navigation entry, which is `evaluateNavigationVisibility` over the shell evaluator. Its roots are the ones `buildExpressionScope` binds: `current_user` (and the `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user` aliases) and `features`. No `data` is bound for a landing entry. A predicate naming any other root (`record`, `app`) faults in the engine.
- **The fault face, pinned.** A faulting predicate is passed over and reported once by the navigation evaluator's own report (the `withholding` line); the next entry is asked. This is the `fail-soft-log` face the dogfood row predicted.
- **What can be landed on.** The `item` is looked up by `id`, at any depth, in the trees as the member is shown them: `navigation` first, then each `areas[].navigation`. An entry the member's navigation gates hide is passed over. An entry whose route opens nothing inside the app (`buildItemRoute` answers empty) is passed over too, as defence only: the spec now refuses every such target at parse (below).
- **The spec refuses a `url` landing (contract review 6551992138, must-fix ④.1; claim amendments 6551999260, 6552162223).** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`: `url` joins `group`, `separator` and `action` in `LANDING_TARGET_REFUSED_TYPES`, so `checkAppLandingItems` refuses it at `landing.N.item`, and the refusal message no longer lists `url` among the entries that open something; the `item` describe, the schema docblock and `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`'s refused list say so. A `url` entry opens an external address and the app-root landing is an in-app redirect, so before this a `url` landing passed both doors and landed nobody, in silence. The changeset declares the narrowing with a FROM → TO line, and the ADR-0087 disposition is the new semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.app-landing-url-item-refused.ts` (marker `registered app-landing-url-item-refused`; no conversion). `landing` arrived after `@objectstack/spec` 18.2.0 (published 2026-10-27; #28449 merged 2026-10-31), so no published build accepted a `url` landing.
- **A `doc` landing (should-fix ④.2): the docblock option.** A `doc` entry lands: it opens the in-app docs portal, under the server's audience gate on the doc (objectstack#19790), without the sidebar's doc-readability answer. `navEntriesShownToMember`'s docblock (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`), which said no consumer lands on a `doc`, now says this, and so do the spec's `landing` JSDoc and `appDeclaredLanding.ts`. I did not pass the sidebar's doc check into the landing trees: the server already drops a doc the reader may not open, and the sidebar's answer is defence in depth behind it.
- **Deriving from the refined mirror (should-fix ④.3).** The changeset says `AppComponentSchema` now carries a refinement, so derive from it with `.shape` or `.safeExtend()`.
- **Pending reads.** The objectui#13097 double ask is kept: the declared landing is resolved over the shown trees and over the trees as they would be once pending entry reads answer, and the root holds on a skeleton while the two disagree.
- **objectui's `app` node runs the spec's check.** `AppComponentSchema` chains `checkAppLandingItems`, so a dangling or non-openable `item`, and a `visible` that reads `data`, are refused at objectui's door with the spec's own issue. The census row in `spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts` moves the check from `notAttachable` to `attached`.
- **Ledgers.** Liveness `app.landing` (and `item`, `visible`) flips `planned` → `live`, `authorWarn` and `authorHint` dropped, evidence citing the read point, and its note says a `url` item is refused at parse; `state-counts/app.md` regenerated. Dogfood `cel-app-landing` re-classified `experimental` / `unevaluated` → `enforced` / `fail-soft-log`, its enforcement cell naming the evaluator.
- **Prose (seat amendments 6550410778, 6550418134).** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`: the `landing` describe loses "[PLANNED — not yet rendered]" and "No console reads this list yet …", and the JSDoc's PLANNED paragraph and the `HOME_PAGE_ID_RETIRED` docblock line now say the console reads it. No schema shape changes; the one accept-set change is the `url` refusal above. Reference docs regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, 2 artifacts, again after the `url` refusal). `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` updated as in the Skills-docs line.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.declaredLanding-28450.test.tsx` (new, 12 tests, through the real `AppContent`, `ExpressionProvider` and `MePermissionsProvider`):
  - two entries, first predicate false and second true → opens on the second entry's item (not the first navigation item);
  - both hold → the first wins, and an item inside a group is landed on;
  - no entry holds → the first navigation item by `order`;
  - a faulting predicate → passed over, one distinct console report, `withholding` face;
  - a root outside the scope (`record`, `app`) → faults, passed over, reported;
  - the `user` / `ctx.user` / `os.user` aliases read the same member;
  - an item the member's object-read gate hides → passed over;
  - an item of `areas[].navigation` → landed on;
  - control: no `landing` key → the first navigation item.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/app-landing.test.ts`: the refused-type table gains a `url` case (`nav_help_site`, refused at `landing.0.item` as a `url` navigation entry), and the dangling-item case asserts the message does not offer the `url` entry.
- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`: three refusals (dangling `item`, a `group` item, a `data` read) reach `AppComponentSchema` and the published door with the spec's own `custom` issue at the spec's path; controls pass on all three doors.
- Two existing types pins accounted for the refinement: `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` lists `checkAppLandingItems` among the chained spec check functions, and `app-actions-retired-7469.test.ts`'s control rebuilds the mirror from its `shape` because zod refuses `.omit()` on an object that carries refinements.

## Acceptance notes

- **The sidebar does not follow a landing into a second area: #28497.** A landing on an `areas[1+].navigation` entry opens the right page while the sidebar shows the first area; the card carries the fix (the sidebar elects the area the current route lives in). Out of this PR, per contract review 6551992138 ④.4.
- **`features` is bound but not pinned through `AppContent`.** It arrives from the auth config after the first render; a landing predicate on `features` decides on whatever the scope holds when the root renders, the same as a navigation `visible` on it.
